Then came years of commission sales, including insurance at State Farm and Allstate, where I learned that the honest answer sometimes loses you the sale and you give it anyway.

I taught myself to build software with AI. Bird League, a competitive birding app, went from zero lines of code to real users and an App Store submission. This year a Sonoma County children's nonprofit became my first client. On my own time I've built a birding league, an indie game matchmaker and a detective game for birders.

Behind all of it is a simple system I built for myself: written rules the AI has to follow, and checks that have to pass before anything goes out. That system is why the work comes out right.
